scoring_justification: Checker recomputes phase classification accuracy from agent's CSV against hidden gold labels derived from Fig.4; for critical_params it compares reported T_N and beta to paper values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold phase labels for test points (H,T)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from Fig.4 and phase regions described in the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Selected points in unambiguous phase regions (paramagnet, phase6, phase7) based on the published phase diagram boundaries; labels assigned according to expected Fourier order-parameter criteria.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the true phase assignments for those (H,T) points according to the paper's Monte Carlo phase diagram, used to verify accurate reproduction.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for T_N and beta from paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports T_N(L=12)=7.06±0.03 and β=0.24±0.03; text and Fig.3/4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper's reported central values and uncertainties.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results.

outputs.description: Per-point phase classification for test points supplied in /app/inputs/test_points.csv; the checker recomputes classification accuracy against hidden gold labels extracted from the paper's Fig. 4.
Estimated zero‑field Néel temperature T_N for L=12 and critical exponent β at H=0, compared to paper‑reported values with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts must be produced by the agent via the simulation and analysis pipeline. The checker will recompute accuracy from phase_labels.csv and compare the critical parameters to paper values. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
